segments.he: אָמַר לַעֲשָׂרָה: ״כִּתְבוּ גֵּט״. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן, אָמַר לַעֲשָׂרָה: ״כִּתְבוּ גֵּט, וּתְנוּ לְאִשְׁתִּי״ – אֶחָד כּוֹתֵב עַל יְדֵי כּוּלָּם. ״כּוּלְּכֶם כְּתוֹבוּ״ – אֶחָד כּוֹתֵב בְּמַעֲמַד כּוּלָּם. ״הוֹלִיכוּ גֵּט לְאִשְׁתִּי״ – אֶחָד מוֹלִיךְ עַל יְדֵי כּוּלָּם. ״כּוּלְּכֶם הוֹלִיכוּ״ – אֶחָד מוֹלִיךְ בְּמַעֲמַד כּוּלָּם.
segments.en: The mishna teaches that if a man «said to ten» people: «Write» and give «a bill of divorce» to my wife, one of the ten writes the bill of divorce and two sign it. «The Sages taught:» If «one said to ten» people: «Write a bill of divorce and give» it «to my wife, one writes on behalf of them all.» If he said: «All of you write» the document, «one writes» it «in the presence of them all.» If he said: «Deliver a bill of divorce to my wife, one» person «brings» it «on behalf of them all.» If he said: «All of you deliver» a bill of divorce, then «one brings» it «in the presence of them all.»

moves.summary: Mishna lemma: said to ten 'write a get'
Baraita distinguishes 'write/deliver' from 'all of you write/deliver'

positions.claim: 'Write/deliver': one acts for all; 'all of you': one acts in the presence of all
